headerDescription: Learn how AI creates your personalized English learning journey—from assessing your current level to generating lessons, quizzes, and daily study plans.

section1.title: About CareerPath AI English Learning Path
section1.description: {{name}} is an intelligent platform designed to help learners improve their English through personalized learning experiences. By analyzing your current proficiency and learning goals, AI generates a customized learning path with interactive lessons, quizzes, and daily study plans to support continuous progress.

practice.title: Practice
practice.description: Study AI-generated lessons that match your current English level. Each lesson includes vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, and practical examples to build real communication skills.

exam.title: Exam
exam.description: After each lesson, complete interactive quizzes to reinforce your knowledge. AI adapts future content based on your performance and learning progress.

stepDetails.label: Step 1
stepDetails.title: Career Path
stepDetails.description: Choose the {{title}} that matches your interests and future goals. Whether you want to become a Software Engineer, Project Manager, Business Analyst, or another professional, your learning journey begins here.

stepDetails.label: Step 2
stepDetails.title: Placement Test
stepDetails.description: Take an AI-powered English {{title}} to evaluate your current proficiency in vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, and other essential language skills.

stepDetails.label: Step 3
stepDetails.title: Personalized English Learning Path
stepDetails.description: Based on your career choice and placement test results, AI generates a {{title}} with structured topics, interactive lessons, quizzes, and daily learning recommendations tailored to your goals.

stepDetails.label: Step 4
stepDetails.title: View Results
stepDetails.description: Open {{title}} to review your test outcome, learning progress, completed lessons, quiz performance, and personalized recommendations.

section4.title: Learning Progress
section4.description: The {{title}} page gives you a complete overview of your learning journey. Monitor completed lessons, quiz performance, learning streaks, and overall improvement as you move toward your English goals.
items: Track daily learning streaks and achievements

cta.title: Ready to Start Learning?
cta.description: <1>Start Now</1> to begin your personalized English learning journey today and let AI guide you through lessons, quizzes, and daily practice designed just for you.

feedback.title: Have suggestions or feedback?
feedback.description: We'd love to hear your ideas and continuously improve your learning experience.
